skills.name: skill_builder
skills.description: Builds new reusable skills by writing system prompts and registering them in the skill registry.

skills.name: orchestrator
skills.description: Routes user requests to the right skill and sequences multi-step workflows across agents.

skills.name: code-inspector-agent
skills.description: Read-only static analysis that inspects source files and produces a health report: bugs, inefficiencies, security issues, bad practices, convention checks, and a 1-10 quality score.

skills.name: refactor-agent
skills.description: Improves source code quality without changing behavior; rewrites inefficient code, removes duplication, simplifies logic, improves readability, and suggests better architecture and design patterns.

skills.name: review-agent
skills.description: Compares original and improved code, explains every change in plain English, estimates performance impact, suggests further improvements, and generates a structured review report.

skills.name: repo-doctor
skills.description: Diagnoses a full-stack app repo and returns a prioritized, actionable fix list so the app becomes functional. Use when the user pastes a GitHub repo URL or bundled codebase and asks why it's broken, why it won't run, or what needs to be fixed.
